title.narrative: Enhance productive capacity, entrepreneurship and improve labor market skills for youth employment creation in Morogoro region
Enhance productive capacity, entrepreneurship and improve labor market skills for youth employment creation in Morogoro region

description.narrative:
Development challenges/ problems the project will address: Lack entrepreneurship and vocational skill and reproductive skills and resources, which limit them to generate incomes
Project beneficiaries: Total number of 300 unemployed/underemployed youth will be the direct beneficiaries of the project interventions in three identified districts (Kilosa, Mvomero and Morogoro rural) The project has targeted to work with groups of youth who will be engaged in the production of horticulture and legumes crops (food processing) on Pigeon-pea/Soya-Biscuits, Yoghurt, Irish Potatoes and Dried-Banana and Pineapple (Snacks). Project results To empower the targeted youth to acquire vocational skills in processing of agricultural products and facilitating emergence of job-creating opportunities for youth to improve their economic development. The project will further empower the youth to use the entrepreneurship skills to establish and manage 12 enterprises from the business opportunities available within their local villages. To achieve this desire, the project will engage 300 youth to a business idea of processing nutritional snacks, horticulture and legumes, for selling to children at schools, local shops, super markets and export to abroad with support from Agri cycle international Company and advocate economic issues affecting youth in their productive activities for policy influence in favor of youth.
The organization was selected through call for the proposal and they fitted in the criteria as announced during the call: e.g. legally registered, they have sound financial management and internal control system, they have relevant policies to guide the organization, they have human resources and infrastructures, and they have experiences working on the theme and international donors, statuary compliances. The project will be implemented by MVIWAMORO in collaboration with other stakeholders such Tanzania Small industries Development organization-SIDO, Ministry of Finance, Private sector and local government.
